high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation or a document, featuring a quote attributed to Alan Turing from his 1950 paper "Computing Machinery And Intelligence." The background of the slide is white with a dark gray border on the left side. The title at the top reads, "Turing was far more modest — as scientists should be," in bold black font. Below the title, there is a block of text in a smaller font size, which is a excerpt from Turing's paper.
